$comment: THE SINGLE SWITCH for owner-facing delivery. Both owner-facing paths read this file:
the scheduled digest and the Duo push. Changing `channel` here changes both; there is
no second place to set it.
This ships as the harness default. An operator's own choice overrides it in place.
2026-08-23: this said `telegram-image-full` until the Telegram connector was removed
from the product. `email` is not a preference being asserted here -- it is the only
channel that still exists, and it is set explicitly so nothing points at a deleted one.
An earlier request had asked that reports go to the messaging channel rather than email;
that request is not withdrawn, it simply has no channel to name right now. Choosing the
replacement (the agent-comms journal, the product's own mobile app, or email as it now
stands) is an owner decision -- see the header of src/lib/owner-delivery.js for what the
digest actually loses, which is the phone-shaped IMAGE rather than the report itself.
